title: Device Authorization
description: State of one in-flight OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628). The device_code is confidential and is never rendered to a transport; only the user_code and verification_uri are shown, and neither is a credential. One pending grant per provider.

userCode.description: Short code the operator types at the verification URL. Single-use and short-lived; it authorizes only this pending grant and grants nothing on its own.

verificationUri.description: Public provider URL the operator opens. Safe to render.

verificationUriComplete.description: Optional provider-supplied URL with the code embedded, so the operator need not type it.

intervalSeconds.description: Minimum polling interval the provider requires. Never poll faster; increase on slow_down.

pollingDeadline.description: keryx's own bound on total polling, independent of the provider's, so a stalled grant cannot poll indefinitely.

state.description: denied and expired are terminal and require a new grant. superseded means a later request for the same provider replaced this one, which stops polling.
